# Reviewed mobile design snapshot

This dist is a reviewed snapshot generated from the Atum design source. It is
not regenerable in this repository. It contains the approved design resources
and their original manifest, consumed by the mobile design importer.

The resources retain their original source and font provenance. Update them only
through a reviewed snapshot and an explicit mobile consumer pin bump. No producer
source is included here. This README is excluded from Git archives so the importer
receives exactly the members declared in manifest.json.
